svg.aria-label: What I am working on and learning: Building Story Loom AI, an AI-driven storytelling platform: its art, its rendering and its 3D worlds. Turning single images into 3D worlds you can explore. Real-time visualization of story scenes, on the web with three.js and in Unreal Engine 5. Crafting procedural, hyper-realistic environments that react to stories dynamically. Merging advanced game AI with cinematic, player-driven storytelling. Generative AI for art: keeping characters and style consistent from one scene to the next. Reading depth and shape from a single image and rebuilding it in 3D. Integrating real-time AI generation pipelines directly into Unreal Engine 5. Coaxing Nanite and Lumen into rendering trillion-polygon worlds.
